dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit sharp dark perimeter edges with a distinct gradient transition to lighter gray interiors. A prominent closed 'O' structure in the mid-body region shows a high-contrast boundary with an elliptical geometry.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Small, localized clusters of low-intensity dark pixels are distributed non-uniformly, primarily localized within the centers of macro-annuli or in the interstitial spaces between 'C' shapes. There is a low spatial density of isolated high-intensity solid pixel clusters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest macro-annuli in the central dorsal region form an irregular trapezoid. Three smaller 'C' shaped clusters near the posterior end form a tight triangular configuration relative to the dorsal midline.
